remarks: Charming and well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath Cape situated on a generous lot in a convenient Stamford location. This inviting home features a spacious living room with tons of character and a cozy wood-burning fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The finished attic provides versatile bonus space ideal for a home office, guest area, or playroom, while the finished basement offers additional living space, storage, and flexibility to suit your needs. Enjoy outdoor entertaining on the large deck overlooking the expansive backyard, perfect for gatherings, gardening, or recreation. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, public transportation, and major commuter routes, this property offers easy access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North train service, and a variety of local amenities. A wonderful opportunity to own a home with character, extra space, and a sizable yard in a sought after Stamford neighborhood.
